The Court made the following;
 Order:
Heard the learned  counsel appearing for the petitioners and the learned  Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for the State.

2.
 The learned  counsel for the petitioners submits that the Sub-Divisional  Co-operative Officer, Proddatur, lodged a complaint  on 01.07.2025 alleging  misappropriation of funds  of FSCS Ltd., Mydukur.

Based on the said  complaint, the police registered Crime No.262 of 2025  on the file of Mydukur  (U/G) Police Station, Y.S.
 R. District, for the alleged offences under Sections  409 and 420 read with 34 of IPC  and Section 79(1) (f) of the A.P. Co-operative  Societies Act, 1964.

3  4. Considering the submissions, the Station House Officer, Mydukur (U/G)
